role: P04e2 Claude implementation writer. Sole active writer.
goal: PostgresDecisionLogAdapter: append(entry) derives tenant from entry.request.tenantId, writes one attested tenant transaction (BEGIN; SELECT mfk_begin_tenant_context; INSERT ... RETURNING; verify; COMMIT) into policy_decision_log, and returns the frozen DecisionLogAppendReceipt. A pure, DB-independent verifyPersistedDecisionLogRow recomputes P04d's canonical SHA-256 from the returned row's payload alone -- never trusting entry.entryHash -- binding id/tenant_id/prev_hash to the payload after undoing JSONB key reordering. The three known chain-integrity SQLSTATE violations (duplicate genesis, fork, orphan predecessor) surface as one frozen, non-retryable DecisionLogChainConflictError; every other DB error propagates unmasked.

designDecisions.boundSafeAppend: adapter.append is assigned as an instance arrow-function field in the constructor, closing over #pool by lexical scope rather than `this` -- so `new DecisionLogPort({ append: adapter.append })` never needs .bind(adapter).
designDecisions.tenantDerivation: tenantId is read only from entry.request.tenantId.toString(); append(entry) takes no tenant option.
designDecisions.genuineEntryAdmission: Reuses DecisionLogPort's brand-check pattern: isExactly(entry, DecisionLogEntry) plus a captured entryHash getter invoked as a private-field probe, so a plain object impersonating the shape is refused with TypeError before any DB work.
designDecisions.oneTransaction: BEGIN; SELECT mfk_begin_tenant_context($1::uuid); INSERT ... RETURNING id,tenant_id,entry_hash,prev_hash,payload; verify the returned row; COMMIT -- verification runs before commit, so an integrity failure still rolls back.
designDecisions.verifierIndependence: verifyPersistedDecisionLogRow never reads entry.entryHash; it recomputes SHA-256 from the row's own payload, using P04d's exact fixed root key order and the same recursive descending-key-order rule applied to requestResource/requestContext, after first validating every field's primitive/null/ordinary-object shape and binding id/tenant_id/prev_hash to the payload.
designDecisions.chainConflictMapping: Exactly SQLSTATE 23505 policy_decision_log_one_genesis_per_tenant, 23505 policy_decision_log_one_successor_per_predecessor, and 23503 policy_decision_log_prev_hash_same_tenant_fk map to one frozen DecisionLogChainConflictError (code DECISION_LOG_CHAIN_CONFLICT, retryable false, tenantId/entryId/prevHash); every other error propagates unchanged, and every failure path rolls back with the client always released.
designDecisions.p06Extension: kernelCapabilityAdapterFiles, a new optional code-frozen manifest field in tools/check-kernel-persistence-ownership.mjs, analogous to kernelCapabilityMigrations -- absent it, the legacy empty-adapter baseline holds; present, it must restate exactly ["postgres-decision-log-adapter.mjs"], and the manifest opts in.
